Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live"

SPECIFICATION  FOR         "*:   *i'FF/Htf£j  jhof 
SCREW,  BONE,  LEINBACH,  MEDULLARY 


1.  Scope  — Specifies  dimensions  and  other  requirements  for  leinbach  medullary  bone  screw  for 
use  in  fractures  of  the  olecranon. 

2.  Material  —  Any  of  the  materials  specified  in  3  of  IS  :  5347-1969  •  General  requirements  of  metal 
surgical  implants  \ 


3-  Shape  and  Dimensions  —  As  shown  in  Fig.  1. 


-0- 


SELF  TAPPING  END  ,  ALTERNATE  SHAPE 


.11  OIA 


1-0  WIDE  CUT,  2*0  DEEP 
5\6DIA-i 


A  =  100,  125,  150 

All  dimensions  in  millimetres. 

FIG.  1     SCREW,  BONE,  LEINBACH,  MEDULLARY 

3.1  The  thread  profile  shall  be  according  to  Indian  Standard  specification  for  thread,  bone  screws 
(  under  preparation ). 

Note  — Until  this  specification  is  published  the  thread  profile  shall  be  subject  to  agreement  between  the  purchaser 
and  the  manufacturer. 

4.  Workmanship  and  Finish 

4.1  The  screw  shall  be  symmetrical  about  its  central  line. 

4.2  The  threads  shall  be  well  formed  and  clean. 

4.3  The  surfaces  of  the  screw  shall  be  free  from  cracks,  draw-marks,  pits,  burrs,  surface  contamina- 
tions and  impregnated  foreign  particles. 

4.4  The  screw  shall  be  passivated  and  polished  bright  except  the  threaded  portion. 

5.  Tests 

5.1  Corrosion  Resistance  Test  —  Shall  be  according  to  6.1  of  IS  :  5347-1969. 

5.2  Radiological  Test  —  Shall  be  according  to  6.2  of  IS  :  5347-1969. 

6.  Marking  -  Shall  be  according  to  5  of  IS  :  5347-1969. 

6.1  ISI  Certification  Marking  -  Details  available  with  the  Indian  Standards  Institution. 

7.  Packing  —  As  agreed  to  between  the  purchaser  and  the  supplier. 


Adopted  20  December,  1973
